method: Safe SVG scene import of supplied expanded paths; original path geometry, six editable layer groups, white details, palette and clipping preserved. No bitmap tracing or font substitution.

providedSourceRecord.title: APEC at a Glance, December 2006
providedSourceRecord.reconstruction_method: Extract original vector paths, preserving their curves, fill, stroke and halo clip. No image tracing.

path_identification.halo-white-base: White outer oval background; used in official cover to support striped halo on dark page.
path_identification.native-path-01: Globe white outline, stroke width 0.284 source units
path_identification.native-path-02: White graticule grid, stroke width 0.213 source units
path_identification.native-path-09 through native-path-48: 40 green continent and island paths, original z-order after letterforms
path_identification.native-path-43: Main continental silhouette (Asia and Americas, connected across far-north edge)

providedSourceRecord.geometry_note: Original PDF global transform retained in each path: matrix(1,0,0,-1,-235.47202,1443.2001). The raw extracted SVG viewBox is 76 91.8 88 45. Inkscape export-area-drawing PNG made for visual review. Exact overall artwork bounds are approximately x 76.60798, y 91.83754, width 86.584, height 44.574 in extracted source units.
providedSourceRecord.reference_comparison: This is the historical globe design including Antarctica, white grid, compressed APEC letters and striped halo. Uploaded raster reference has denser finer halo lines and darker/smaller-color-palette rendering. Preserve native map/glyph geometry while treating any palette/halo adjustment as a reference-matched derivative, rather than calling it an unmodified official original.
